text_block_list.text: Nice Nature will not be coming here today. Because—
After the Arima Kinen, Nice Nature asked Mejiro McQueen and Mejiro Ryan about the secret to their strength.

Today, I've been invited by them to learn the secret behind their strength.
...Consider it a one-day study abroad program with the Mejiro family.

Nice Nature has a good head on her shoulders.
I'm sure she'll come back having gained something.
Believing in her, I decided to wait for her return—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—As expected, that Darjeeling tea earlier was in a
league of its own from the aroma alone. Truly a blessing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"They say every single step up to the finish is done by hand!
You really can trust a craftsman's work."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Um.
What's the situation here? Why a tea party?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I honestly thought
we were heading to the training track or something...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I shall head over shortly. However,
savoring black tea is also part of my routine."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: A routine...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Today, we would like Nature-san
to see us just as we normally are."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Exactly!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Anyway, it's about that time, so let's head out for training!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah, y-yes...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back, McQueen!
What are you doing after this?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Naturally, one more rep.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Your speed on the 10th lap dropped
a bit compared to before. ...Didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Sure thing, go ahead and
run until you're satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, I shall be on my way!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hah... Hah... Whoaaa...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, welcome back, Nature-chan!
McQueen just headed out a moment ago!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I was watching...!
Is she really going to keep running...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Not done, or rather, not even close?
She did say she 'wanted to build up speed,' after all.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You're blessed with that much stamina,
and you're asking for even more...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...No matter how strong McQueen gets, she still thinks her current self isn't good enough.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That just shows how high she's aiming.
That's why she never stops working hard.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Seeing someone push like that all the time
makes you feel like you've gotta step it up too, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Nnnngh.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'm heading out too...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Such a sore loser!
Have a good one!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—Pheww!
Squats done!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my quads are really feeling the burn now~!
Yes, this is it, gotta have this feeling!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, but Nature-san
seems to have collapsed over there...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Man, she really kept up, didn't she!
That girl's got real guts!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'm sure she'll be back on her feet soon, so could you keep an eye on her for me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Would you like to hear the rest?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! You gotta keep at it
while you can really feel it working!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Alright!
Next up, attacking the pecs!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, not even a break...?
Ryan-senpai is built totally different...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh my, are you feeling all right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah. I'm okay.
Though it was pretty reckless...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I knew Ryan-senpai loved working out,
but... I didn't expect it to be this intense."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Of course, part of it is that she simply likes it, but...
Ryan does not believe in her own strength.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why she never slacks off.
Constantly wanting more, she recklessly pushes herself to the limit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Then I too must ensure I am always ready
to challenge her as she continues aiming for new heights."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —Thank you so much for today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Man, we ended up dragging you along
with our training all day, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: No, that was the right call!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...I finally realized.
I've really just been acting totally selfish all this time."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
They were truly looking right at each other.
They acknowledge each other's strength and compete as equals.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Still, all I ever do...
is crave the strength other people have."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
All I could see were my shortcomings...
I never even stopped to think
about what I actually had.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...And?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I intend to face it properly.
Both the other girls... and myself."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's great!
I'm sure it'll add to your strength, Nature-chan!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Um...
May I ask one last thing?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Why did you two decide to help me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...It is noblesse oblige, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Pfft! You're just trying to hide your embarrassment, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
My real reason is so that I can become even stronger.
By clashing with someone as strong as you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
“—We're planning to enter the upcoming
'Takarazuka Kinen' too, you see!”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what a fine expression.
Well then, let us meet next at Hanshin.

When I saw Nice Nature the next day,
she had a refreshed look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I... want to beat those two.
âAt the Takarazuka Kinen!
